title: Is healthy living only for the rich?
situation: An international youth magazine is running a series called "Healthy Living Around the World". The editors have asked readers to write articles on the question: "Is a healthy lifestyle only for those who can afford it?" Write an article for the magazine.
situationHu: Egy nemzetközi ifjúsági magazin cikket kér arról, hogy csak a jómódúak engedhetik-e meg maguknak az egészséges életmódot.

points.text: describe the eating and exercise habits of young people in your country
discuss why many people think that a healthy lifestyle is expensive
give your own opinion on the question, supported by reasons and examples
suggest what schools or families could do to help young people live more healthily

usefulPhrases.hu: A feldolgozott élelmiszer gyakran olcsóbb a friss terméknél.

modelAnswer.text:
Healthy Living on a Tight Budget

Have you ever thought about how much a healthy lifestyle really costs?

In Hungary, many teenagers skip breakfast and grab a pastry or an energy drink on the way to school. These days more and more young people spend their afternoons in front of screens, and apart from PE lessons, a lot of them hardly do any exercise at all.

It is often argued that living healthily is a luxury. Processed food is usually cheaper than fresh produce, and a gym membership can cost a small fortune. Social media makes things worse by suggesting that you need expensive superfoods and designer sportswear to be fit.

However, I do not think this is necessarily the case. The healthiest food is often the simplest: lentils, oats, seasonal vegetables and apples from the local market cost far less than takeaway meals. Similarly, running in the park, cycling to school or following a free workout video at home costs nothing at all. My older brother got into great shape last year without ever setting foot in a gym.

Schools and families both have a role to play. Schools could offer healthier canteen meals and more free after-school sports clubs, while parents could cook with their children and show them how to shop on a budget.

Taking everything into account, a healthy lifestyle depends far more on knowledge and habits than on money.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: mind a négy szempont kifejtett – a magyar fiatalok étkezése és mozgása, a „drága” vélemény három okkal, saját álláspont konkrét példákkal (lencse, zab, piaci alma, ingyenes edzésvideó, a báty esete), végül javaslat az iskolának és a családnak is.

Szövegalkotás: cikkhez illő felépítés – figyelemfelkeltő cím és kérdés az olvasóhoz, majd a másik oldal ismertetése (It is often argued that …) és cáfolata (However, …), a végén összegző mondat (Taking everything into account, …).
Hangnem: félhivatalos magazinstílus összevont alakok nélkül, de közvetlenül megszólítja az olvasót, ahogy egy ifjúsági lapban szokás.

Szókincs és nyelvhelyesség: érdemes megtanulni: cost a small fortune, without ever setting foot in a gym, on a budget, have a role to play; a hasonlító szerkezetek (far less than, far more on … than on …) pontosak.
